tasks.label: C/C++: gcc.exe build entire project
args: Set-Location src; $files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter '*.c' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; & 'C:\MinGW\bin\gcc.exe' -fdiagnostics-color=always -g $files -I . -o main.exe
tasks.detail: Recursively compiles all .c files under src/ into main.exe
